text:
sara_sales: Hey team — customer (FinGuard) asked for ISO 27001 alignment proof for the POC. They want scope, policies, and applicability statements before we start the trial. Any quick checklist we can share?

ali_security: @sara_sales quick Qs — will POC use hosted Redwood API or Dedicated capacity? scope changes based on where data lives.

sara_sales: Hosted API for now; they said no regulated data in POC, but will run sample invoices (PII-ish). POC timeline: 2 weeks, needs docs today if possible.

ali_security: OK. For hosted POC we can provide: ISMS scope statement, certification status (ISO cert if available), high-level SoA/applicability matrix, relevant policies (access control, encryption, incident mgmt), and SOC2 summary if needed. We need to redact any internal IP.

matt_engineering: Also add a short environment diagram + confirmation of tenant separation and ephemeral creds for the POC. They usually ask about logs retention and where keys are stored.

ali_security: Good point. From security side we'll include: KMS usage (customer vs platform keys), data at rest encryption, TLS in transit, RBAC for API keys, and audit logging retention window.

dana_poc: I can stand up a dedicated POC org with scoped API keys and limited dataset. Need a checklist of exact files to upload to their vendor risk portal. They requested a Statement of Applicability (SoA) — do we have a short form?

ali_security: We have a condensed SoA for sales purposes. Shareable items (redacted):

```
- ISMS Scope: "Redwood Inference — hosted inference platform excluding experimental research clusters; excludes employee HR systems."
- SoA: mapping of ISO controls -> implemented/partially/NOT APPLICABLE (redacted technical notes)
- Policies: Access Control, Crypto, Backup & Restore, Vulnerability Mgmt, Incident Response (PDFs)
- Cert: ISO 27001 cert scan + cert number (if current) or auditor report extract
- Architecture: network diagram + data flow for hosted API
```

ali_security: We'll need legal sign-off to publish the cert copy. If they want raw evidence (audit workpapers) that's escalated.

sara_sales: FinGuard accepts redacted cert + SoA and policy PDFs. They asked also whether our ISMS scope explicitly excludes customer-managed on-prem models — want that spelled out.

ali_security: We'll add a clear sentence in the scope doc: "The ISMS covers Redwood's hosted and Dedicated control plane and inference service; it explicitly excludes customer-managed on-prem deployments and customer-managed model artifacts"

matt_engineering: For the POC I'll produce a one-page network/dataflow that shows ephemeral API keys, no model weights uploaded, and logs sent to our audited SIEM. ETA: 4 hours.

dana_poc: Timeline wise, FinGuard wants docs in <24h to unblock procurement. I can upload to their portal and confirm receipt.

ali_security: I'll assemble the redacted SoA + policy PDFs and scope statement. @security_bot can you attach the latest cert link?

security_bot: <https://vendors.redwood.com/certs/iso27001-2025.pdf> (access: sales-team, expires 2026-05-01) :white_check_mark:

ali_security: Uploaded draft bundle to /shared/sales/FinGuard_ISO_package.zip. Please review before I send.

sara_sales: Reviewing now, will ping when uploaded to their portal. Thanks everyone — this should clear procurement blockers. :thumbsup:

matt_engineering: Confirmed network diagram uploaded to the bundle.

sara_sales: FYI — FinGuard replied: "Looks good, please proceed with POC onboarding once policies received." I'll close the loop after upload.

ali_security: Great. If they request SoA evidence drill-down, escalate to security compliance for a scoped response.

sara_sales: Noted. Closing thread once portal upload done.
